$comment: Linux build headers and link stubs included with every Genex build. The checked-in archive is the deterministic output of scripts/toolchains/linux-sysroot.ts --archive, built from the image and package versions recorded inside manifest.json plus the cpal/gilrs link stubs native/linux-sysroot/manifest.json describes (zig 0.16.0, glibc 2.28). Both archive bytes and every extracted file are verified before bundling; the store verifies the resources copy again before installing. No external download or hosting service is needed until the owner publishes it as a release asset.
